title: Bonatella Hot Chocolate
description: A rebranding and packaging refresh for Bonatella Hot Chocolate, transforming the previous design into a more playful and engaging experience for kids. The new identity introduces a vibrant purple palette with warm orange accents, along with friendly character illustrations to create a fun and memorable brand presence. The updated packaging system includes both sachets and a jar format, offering flexibility while maintaining a cohesive and recognizable visual identity across the product line.

title: Mixly Jam Packaging Design
description:
Mixly Jam is a playful and vibrant brand identity bringing freshness and fun to every kitchen.
Inspired by nature, the design is bright, eye-catching, and memorable.
This project explores a contemporary approach to packaging, emphasizing joy, flavor, and visual appeal.
Each element from logo to label layout was crafted for a cohesive brand experience.
The result is a soft, friendly identity that celebrates the simple pleasure of natural jam.

title: Velora Incense
description:
VELORA Incense is a branding concept inspired by the quiet beauty of nature and the timeless ritual of incense.

The visual identity combines an elegant serif logotype with subtle botanical elements, creating a balance between refined luxury and organic warmth. A deep forest green, earthy terracotta, and soft neutral palette builds a calm and sophisticated visual language, while the leaf-inspired symbol reflects the brand’s natural essence.

The identity was extended across packaging, gift sets, and lifestyle applications, focusing on tactile materials, warm tones, and thoughtful details that turn the incense experience into a moment of calm and presence.

Inspired by nature. Pure in essence, timeless in experience.

title: Liwa Honey and Dates Festival
description: The Liwa Ajman Dates & Honey Festival identity celebrates the rich connection between Ajman’s agricultural heritage, nature, and local traditions. Inspired by the date palm and honey bee, the visual language combines organic forms with a warm green and golden palette to create a modern yet culturally rooted identity. The system was carried across the entrance, stage, flags, giveaways, and event graphics, creating a cohesive and welcoming festival experience.

title: Dubai Police — GITEX 2025
description: This project is the result of an incredible team effort, combining diverse expertise and creative vision. Assigned by UMI, I had the privilege, as the graphic designer, of collaborating with talented 3D designers, an inspiring art director, and our CEO to bring this concept to life for Dubai Police at GITEX 2025. Our collective focus was to create a compelling and innovative visual experience that reflects the cutting-edge nature of Dubai Police while engaging and inspiring the audience. From initial brainstorming to final execution, each team member’s unique perspective was instrumental in shaping the project, ensuring it stood out at one of the world’s largest tech exhibitions.

title: Consul Canned Food
description: This packaging design focuses on clarity, consistency, and everyday usability, transforming classic canned beans into a visually cohesive range. Working with an existing logo, the project emphasizes clear hierarchy, warm color palettes, and ingredient-inspired graphics to help each variety stand out while maintaining strong brand unity. The overall approach balances modern simplicity with a sense of honesty and familiarity, resulting in a shelf-ready design that feels both reliable and contemporary.

title: Dazzel Chocolate
description: Dazzle Chocolate was designed to offer a gentle and reassuring indulgence for diabetes consumers. The soft color palette and smooth visual flow create a sense of calm, kindness, and emotional comfort — moving away from the clinical feel often associated with sugar-free products. Each flavor is distinguished by a subtle, friendly color while maintaining a cohesive and peaceful identity. The result is a chocolate experience that feels safe, warm, and joyful — without added sugar.

title: Tete Maxim (croissant)
description: A design crafted to evoke warmth and indulgence, using visually satisfying colors that create a sense of calm while enticing the viewer to experience its soft, delicious appeal, supported by a strong, well-balanced layout.

title: Sano Tea Biscuit
description: The project is a packaging design for Sano Tea Biscuit, featuring a sleek logo with a wheat symbol provided by the client. The design uses a refined color palette and integrate the wheat symbol subtly yet prominently, aiming for an elegant and visually appealing package.

title: Hana Maamoul
description: "Hana maamoul" is a design that embodies an Arabic theme, radiating the warm atmosphere of traditional Arab celebrations.

title: Pocket Sandwich Cookie
description: Pocket Sandwich Cookie is a modern packaging design project created to bring energy and shelf impact to a classic snack category. The design combines bold colors, playful typography, and a clear visual hierarchy to highlight flavor variations while maintaining a cohesive brand identity. The result is a vibrant, consumer-friendly package that feels both fun and premium.

title: Lavetta Cheese
description: After being provided with the logo, it was adjusted a little to produce a design for processed cheese giving the vibes of your mother's kitchen.

title: ALARYA Cosmetics
description: Introducing ALARYA Cosmetics' rebranding and packaging design, combining ancient Egyptian traditions with modern femininity. The design features luxurious illustrations of pharaohs and traditional motifs, set against a soft and elegant color palette. The result is a cohesive and recognizable brand identity for four distinct products - serum, lotion, conditioner, and shampoo - that exude luxury and refinement.
